the relationship of body fat distribution with cardiometabolic disease risk factors in Hispanic adolescent girls is not as strong as that observed in adults.
the relationship between body fat distribution and risk of cardiometabolic disease is present in children and is not dependent on age, pubertal status, or total adiposity.

the distribution of body fat in children is important for cardiometabolic health.
